newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Advance, St George shaky before meet.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Advance, St George shaky before meet.

text.p: The shares of Advance Bank Ltd and St George Bank Ltd were suffering mixed fortunes late on Thursday as investors weighed up the possibility the proposed merger could be blocked by National Australia Bank Ltd.
At 3.40 p.m. (0440 GMT), St George shares were 18 cents higher at A$7.86 while Advance was six cents weaker at A$6.75.

Dealers said nervous investors were mainly responding to a report in the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper which speculated that NAB had built up a near five percent stake in Advance to try and thwart the merger proposal at Monday's meeting of Advance shareholders.
"The price St George is offering for Advance shares is attractive so any possibility the merger could be stopped affects Advance negatively and St George positively," a Brisbane-based analyst said.

National Australia has an eight percent stake in St George and has blocked its attempts to expand, buying converting preference shares in Metway Bank Ltd earlier this year to block St George's unsuccessful bid for Metway.
National Australia has said its St George stake is strategic, but many banking analysts see the stake as a launch-pad for a takeover bid if the St George-Advance deal does not go ahead.
